summary.one_liner: Taiga Backend is the server-side code of the Taiga open-source project management platform, with the README pointing to external docs, bug tracker, community and contribution guides.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly a set of links rather than technical instructions. It points to three documentation hubs: API reference for developers, installation guides for self-hosting Taiga, and user-facing Taiga Resources. It describes how to report bugs (Taiga issues preferred, GitHub issues, or email for security issues) and where to get help or follow release announcements. It also covers contribution routes, a Code of Conduct, and licensing terms for accepted patches. It does not describe features, setup commands, or the backend's technology stack.
use_cases: look up the Taiga API reference
contribute code to an open-source project management tool
notable: Serves as the backend for the Taiga project management platform
Documentation split into API, self-hosting guides, and user resources
Security bugs routed to a separate security contact address
caveats: README is brief and does not include installation or run instructions; it links to external documentation
Some tree.taiga.io support is referenced for a hosted service, and contributors must avoid code not licensable under MPL 2.0
